thread:
Priya: Quick sync — ACME Edge VPC private rollout readiness. Need to confirm three things before we greenlight staging cutover: 1) staging firewall egress rules, 2) air-gap image import plan, 3) DB replication tunnel. Who owns which?
Javier: I can own firewall rules + testing. I pushed the proposed list to the runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/acme-edge-firewall (see section 'staging'). Quick note: customer only allows outbound 443 and 22 right now.
Mike: For DB replication we need a TLS tunnel to their peered DB endpoint. I raised a ticket to infra to provision a bastion + iptables NAT. Ticket: #INF-4821.
Aisha: Re: image import — they are fully air-gapped. We need to produce an OCI bundle and a transfer checklist. Is there a secure courier process or do we expect them to fetch from a S3 presigned archive via an egress appliance?
Sam: We have two supported flows: (a) signed pack on USB courier (compliance-heavy), (b) customer pulls from S3 via an egress proxy we expose over port 443 and we allow their proxy IP. For ACME they preferred option (b) earlier but we need their egress IP list.
Priya: @Sam can you outline the steps + owners for (b) in the runbook? I can coordinate with ACME to get IPs. Also we need checklist items for image validation and hash verification.
Sam: Yup. Steps I'll add today: generate OCI tar -> sign with KMS -> upload to staging S3 -> create one-time presigned URL scoped to their egress IPs -> send transfer token. I'll note validation commands, e.g.:
```
sha256sum acme-edge-oci.tar.gz
gpg --verify acme-edge-oci.tar.gz.sig acme-edge-oci.tar.gz
```
Javier: For firewall testing I'll run a smoke script from their staging subnet: `curl -I https://deploy.redwood.internal/health` and a port scan against allowed ports. Will post results here.
Mike: DB tunnel: infra says bastion will be ready by Thu EOD. If ACME can open 5432 inbound from the bastion IP we should be able to start one-way replication. Need @Priya to confirm ACL change with their network team.
Aisha: One more blocker: ACME's SCCM team requires that any inbound SSH from our ops bastion be restricted to key-based auth and a specific user. Can we confirm the user mapping and rotate keys after onboarding?
Priya: Noted. I'll send ACME a short matrix: egress IPs, expected ports (443, 2022 for SFTP if we need it), authorized SSH user, and timeline.
Javier: Small ask for infra: can we add temporary VPC flow logs for 48h during staging cutover? It helped earlier when we had routing flaps.
Sam: Yes, can enable and stream to staging-logs bucket. Will tag logs with `acme-edge-staging` and TTL 7d.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: image-import-service v1.14 -> staging (blocked: waiting for ACME egress IPs).
Priya: Action items: Javier -> firewall smoke + results by Tue; Sam -> add image transfer steps & enable flow logs; Mike -> follow-up on bastion ETA; Aisha -> confirm key rotation plan with compliance; Priya -> send IP/ports matrix to ACME and request their egress IPs. If anyone can't meet these by Tue EOD call it out. :thumbsup:
Mike: I might be delayed until Wed morning (heads-down on another outage), tagging @Javier if you can start the firewall tests without me.
Javier: I can start and record results; will ping if I need help.
Priya: Thanks everyone — I'll post the updated runbook link once I add the ACME matrix. If ACME replies with IP list, please don't start imports until Sam confirms presigned URL validity.
Aisha: OK, noted.
Sam: I'll add a checklist item: "verify SHA256 + signature and run `ctr images import --all-platforms`" and include rollback steps.
Priya: Closing the loop here tomorrow with a snapshot of progress.
Javier: Thanks, talk soon.
